motivation.text: Scanning an array of $\Theta(n)$ bits at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $n\log n$, so both data movement and arithmetic must be sped up.

root.salient: The exponent $1-\kappa$ is a genuine power saving in $\lg n$, but $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is astronomically small.
